name: La Hacienda
notes: UK trade supplier for rustic outdoor + indoor decorative items — chimineas, fire bowls, lanterns, kitchen accessories. Good complement to main furniture ranges.

name: FRP Advisory (Admin alerts)
notes: One of UK's largest insolvency/administration firms. Register interest in furniture retailer administrations to get EARLY buyer alerts before stock goes to public auction. This is the pre-auction channel serious trade buyers use. Also: Begbies Traynor, Interpath Advisory, Teneo.

name: Begbies Traynor (Admin alerts)
notes: Major UK insolvency practitioner. Register interest in furniture/retail administrations to receive buyer alerts. Pre-auction pricing accessible to serious trade buyers.

name: Muubs
notes: Danish. The purest modern-rustic look in the trade — raw aged oak, blackened iron, hand-thrown stoneware, made new but finished to look salvaged. B2B portal at b2b.muubs.com. Verified live 2026-09-04; minimum order not published, ask the sales contact.

name: Nordal
notes: Danish family-owned, Horsens. Showrooms in Hamburg, Oslo and Amsterdam. Wholesale login at wholesale.nordal.com, and a public outlet section worth watching for end-of-line. Sells retail alongside trade. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Chic Antique
notes: Danish supplier whose whole brief is French country style with a Nordic touch — new stock built to read as old. Closest thing in Europe to a one-stop modern-rustic shop fit-out. B2B only. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: House Doctor (Society of Lifestyle)
notes: Part of the Society of Lifestyle group; retailer portal at retailer.societyoflifestyle.com covers House Doctor and its sister brands in one account. Raw concrete, aged metal, weathered wood. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Bloomingville
notes: Large Danish wholesaler with a formal Become a Retailer route, a named sales team per territory and a published trade-show calendar — an easy first Scandinavian account to open. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Madam Stoltz
notes: Danish, trade-only, accessories-led — baskets, stoneware, textiles, small furniture. Runs a public outlet on Facebook. Good for filling shelves around bigger furniture pieces. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Hübsch Interior
notes: Danish. Self-serve B2B shop plus a permanently open public outlet category — one of the few Scandinavian houses where you can see clearance stock without an account. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Tine K Home
notes: Danish. Has a Become a Retailer route and — unusually — sale sections split by product type (furniture, lamps, ceramics, rugs), so end-of-line is easy to scan without logging in. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Broste Copenhagen
notes: Long-established Danish house, strong on the earthy ceramic and reactive-glaze side that dresses a rustic room. B2B account required. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Affari of Sweden
notes: Swedish. B2B portal in English at b2b.affariofsweden.com and — rare for a Scandinavian wholesaler — an explicit dropship service with a stated dropship fee, so you can list stock before you buy it. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Sika-Design
notes: Danish rattan manufacturer since 1942, handmade indoor and outdoor. The chair to put around a reclaimed-wood table when you want the room to look collected rather than bought as a set. B2B shop at b2b.sika-design.com. Premium — margin comes from ticket size, not discount. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Light & Living (Lightmakers BV)
notes: Dutch, trade-only, exports to 70+ countries and has a GB office. Lighting and shades at volume — the cheapest way to make a rustic room look finished. Account needs a company registration and VAT number in the interiors or lighting trade. Site is behind a bot check; apply through the FAQ/login page. Verified 2026-09-04 (site live, Cloudflare-gated to automated checks).

name: Originalhome
notes: Dutch wholesaler built around recycled and reclaimed materials — old teak, recycled glass, sugarcane. New stock with a genuine reclaimed story you can put on a swing ticket. B2B login plus named sales representatives. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Dutchbone (Zuiver Group)
notes: Dutch. Industrial-rustic at volume, and it runs both a sale and a separate permanent outlet section — the outlet is the reason to keep this one on a weekly check. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: WOOOD
notes: Dutch, high-volume, solid-oak and mango dining and storage at budget trade prices. The workhorse if you need shop-floor stock rather than statement pieces. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Annaghmore Agencies
notes: The single most important trade account on this island if you are opening a shop in Ireland or NI. Family-run since 1977, based on the Annaghmore Road outside Portadown, importer and wholesaler of living, dining and bedroom cabinet plus upholstery. Trade login at trade.annaghmoreagencies.com. Delivers across Ireland and mainland UK from local stock, so no container commitment. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: One.World (One World Trading Company)
notes: Family business since 1989, importing furniture and homeware for trade partners as well as its own retail. Supplies retailers, interior designers, developers, hotels and bars. Runs a periodic warehouse sale worth diarising. Trade route at /pages/trade-customers. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Julian Bowen
notes: One of the biggest UK trade-only distributors. Not a rustic specialist, but the rustic-oak and industrial ranges are stocked deep in Nottingham with fast turnaround, which is what a new shop actually needs. Trade portal at trade.julian-bowen.co.uk. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Carlton Furniture & Vintage Sofa Company
notes: Trade-only, supplies furniture retailers with cabinet, bedroom and upholstery. Publishes a genuinely low minimum — a mixed order of 10 pieces — which is one of the easiest openings for a first shop. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Corndell Furniture
notes: UK maker, Witney. Painted and oak furniture in the English country idiom — the higher end of the new-but-looks-old bracket. Stockist application at /become_stockist.php; expect them to ask about your showroom. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Wood Bros (Old Charm)
notes: Making the Old Charm range since 1924 — solid oak, carved and adzed to read as centuries old. Published retailer terms and a live outlet section. The reference point if a customer asks what 'proper' new oak looks like. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Devonshire Living
notes: Devon-based trade supplier of painted and oak country ranges, with a dedicated stockist portal. Straight down the middle of what a modern-rustic shop sells most of. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Voyage Maison
notes: Scottish. Fabrics, cushions, curtains and upholstery in a soft country palette — the soft-furnishing half of a rustic room, which most furniture wholesalers do badly. Trade account runs through the Riva Home portal. Live outlet section. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Mustard and Gray
notes: UK. French-country homeware and textiles with a published trade-account route and a standing sale section. Good for the small-ticket impulse shelf near the till. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Distinctly Living
notes: Independent family lifestyle shop trading since 2008, sourcing across Europe, with published trade-order terms. Sells retail as well, so margins are thinner — but it is a fast way to buy small quantities of European rustic stock without opening ten accounts. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Gisela Graham
notes: London trade-only decorative wholesaler, very strong at Christmas and Easter. Not furniture — this is the seasonal dressing that keeps a rustic shop looking different every eight weeks. Trade login at trade.giselagraham.co.uk. Verified live 2026-09-04.

name: Something Different Wholesale
notes: Poole-based giftware and homeware wholesaler with a low stated minimum order and a dropship service, so you can trade the accessory side with no stock on the floor. Trade account required. Verified live 2026-09-04.
